# address locality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:addressLocality`](gmeow-addressLocality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/addressLocality>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)

The locality (city or town) coordinate value of a postal address, expressed along the [`gmeow:axisAddressLocality`](../individuals/gmeow-axisAddressLocality.md) axis of the postal reference frame.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:PostalAddress`](../classes/gmeow-PostalAddress.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)
